title: 第十三章 血蛮峰崖第十四章 力战
lines: 此刻玄天站舟正以一种肉眼难以捕捉的速度，遁行于漫天血红风沙之中，即便这战舟此刻的位置处在荒漠上方，数万丈的高空处，其对冲而过的血色飞沙还是遮埋掉战舟正前方，绝大部份的光线。
不过好在的是，雷涅此时，早已开启战舟所具备的巨型青色护罩，将这些包围巨轮周身各处，被狂猛劲风所裹袭的沙尘彻底隔绝于外！
让得被保护于护罩内的众修士，一个个在为此地拥有如此恶劣的天象感到心惊胆颤的同时，对这玄天站舟竟能轻易的将这些狂暴飞沙阻隔在外，更是犹然从心底发出，好似永不止息的惊叹。
于是众修士望向这巨轮主人背影的目光，越发变的恭敬起来。
雷涅在察觉到周围众修士对自己投来的目光变的越发敬重，当即嘴唇微抿了一下。
便继续以一番若无其事的神情，在手上掐出道道印决，操控着玄天战舟急掠过天际，往最终的目的地驶去。
雷涅看似面庞上没有表露出丝毫心绪，但其早就用神念对这一整船的百余名修士进行了不下数十遍的观察与探测，毕竟此次，他也是要利用第二躯体随这百余名修士一同进入血蛮荒漠内的。
早些将这些要与自己一同潜入其内的众修士的各个底细探查清晰，也能早些对血炼的局势做出一翻简单的估测。
雷涅在血炼选拔结束后的当日，便操控着第二躯体赶回了自己的洞府。
在府内利用原先本体所炼制的一众低阶丹药，又是将第二躯体的百余枚位点全部晋升成更高层次的品质。
感受着从第二躯体内不时散溢而开的强悍玄气波动，让得雷涅明白，如今仅凭第二躯体自身的实力境界，便能硬撼普通的凡化境小成修士而不落下风，若是遇上凡化境大成的修士也能有着脱身自保之能。
当然这一切的前提是在自己尚不动用体内神念的情况下。
若是雷涅动用第二躯体内的神念，哪怕其仅能催动淡不可闻的一缕，莫说凡化境的修士，就算是普通灵化境的修士也能被其轻易斩杀！
可最关键的一点在于，雷涅原先就能操控第二躯体内，相当可观的一部分神念。
更别说雷涅还察觉到，通过躯体实力如今的再次增进，较之以往，其还能调控更多的存在于第二躯体内的神念。
这个发现让雷涅感到欣喜的同时，对第二躯体掌控其体内神念的强弱程度又有了进一步的认知。
想来自己操控神念的多少与第二躯体所拥有的玄气雄浑程度，两者间的关系是成正相关的。
像雷涅这种连凡化境的修为都没达到，就能调用神念的情况，恐怕自整个化天界有记载以来，只独出他一人。
要知道对于神念的调用，那是只有修士在达到真丹境以后所享有的独特实力。
真丹境修士在突破修为时，所凝炼出的那么一缕神念，较之其体内磅礴如海的精纯玄气，两者雄浑程度上的差距仿若云泥之别，天地之隔！
也就是在此等，宛如天堑鸿沟般的悬差之下。
修士要以体内玄气操控这么一缕微弱不堪的神念，简直是在信手拈来间便可将其如臂指挥。
可放到雷涅这里，神念与玄气的雄浑程度，两者间的关系却是完全颠转。
即便如今雷涅第二躯体的实力与之前相比，无疑是提升了数个层级，但若想将躯体内所有的神念完全掌控，真不知道要修炼到猴年马月，才能得常所愿！
但相比这种，第二躯体在实力大进后，能操控更多的体内神念。
雷涅更为在意的还是，黑色神念会不会在第二躯体体内精纯玄气的增进下，被炼化为属于自己的本源神念。
就是抱以此种心态，雷涅在第二躯体实力大增之后的三日时间内，一直在洞府中闭目打坐。
调息稳固着，此次第二躯体大幅精进的实力，彻底的将自身心神与洞府外面的世界隔绝而开。
而也就是自雷涅这般忘我修炼的初始，到第三日子时都已过了将近一炷香的时间左右。
雷涅那紧闭的眼皮，于某一刻猛然间睁开，其内涌动着极端的狂喜之色！
嘴里更是狂笑而出一道震人心神的话语。
“本源神念的雄浑程度竟然真的增加了一丝，看来第二躯体玄气的增长真对那些黑色神念有着炼化之效！”
此刻雷涅的意识早已返回本体之中，而在其意识返回本体的一霎那，便感应起同样折返回来的神念本源是否有所增长。
当然最终探查的结果也是让雷涅没有感到丝毫失望就是。
这才导致，其先前在最终确定了自己本源神念的诡异增幅竟真的与第二躯体实力精进有着莫大的联系后，会那般的癫狂失态。
因为这一点的确定，可是让雷涅在神念的修炼上比同级修士多出了一条，绝对堪称平坦的捷径！
content_en:
At this moment, Xuantian's station boat was flying through the blood-red wind and sand in the sky at a speed that was difficult to catch with the naked eye. Even though the war boat was above the desert at an altitude of tens of thousands of feet, the blood-colored flying sand rushing past it still obscured most of the light directly in front of the war boat.
But the good thing is that at this time, Rene has already opened the giant cyan shield of the war boat, which completely isolates the sand and dust that surrounds the giant wheel and is blown by the fierce wind!
The monks who were protected within the protective barrier were all frightened by the harsh celestial phenomena. At the same time, they were also amazed from the bottom of their hearts that the Xuantian Station Boat could easily block these violent flying sands.
Then the monks looked at the back of the owner of the giant wheel and became more and more respectful.
When Rene noticed that the surrounding monks were looking at him with more respect, he immediately pursed his lips slightly.
Then he continued with a nonchalant expression, pinching out seals in his hands, and controlled the Xuantian war boat to fly across the sky, heading towards its final destination.
Rene didn't seem to show any emotion on his face, but he had already used his spiritual thoughts to observe and detect the hundreds of monks on the ship dozens of times. After all, this time, he also wanted to use his second body to follow the hundreds of monks into the Blood Savage Desert.
The sooner he could find out the details of the monks who wanted to sneak into the place with him, the sooner he could make a simple estimate of the situation in Blood Refinery.
On the day after the blood training selection, Rene controlled the second body and rushed back to his cave.
A number of low-level elixirs were refined in the mansion using the original body, and all the hundreds of points in the second body were upgraded to a higher level of quality.
Feeling the powerful profound energy fluctuations that emanated from the second body from time to time, Delene understood that now, with the strength of the second body alone, it could defeat ordinary monks who were in the mortal realm without falling behind. If they encountered monks who were in the mortal realm, they would also be able to escape and protect themselves.
Of course, the premise of all this is that you have not yet used the spiritual thoughts in your body.
If Reine uses the divine thought in his second body, even if it can only activate an inaudible ray, not to mention the monks in the mortal realm, even the monks in the ordinary spiritual realm can be easily killed by it!
But the most critical point is that Rene was able to control a considerable part of the spiritual thoughts in the second body.
Not to mention that Rene also noticed that through the current increase in physical strength, he can control more spiritual thoughts existing in the second body than before.
This discovery made Rene feel happy, and at the same time he gained a further understanding of the strength of the second body's control over the spiritual thoughts in his body.
Thinking about it, there is a positive correlation between how much you control your spiritual thoughts and how powerful your mysterious energy is in your second body.
Like Reine, who has not even reached the realm of mortal transformation and is able to call upon his spiritual thoughts, I am afraid that he is the only one who has been recorded in the entire world of transformation.
You must know that the use of spiritual thoughts is a unique strength that only monks enjoy after reaching the true elixir realm.
The wisp of spiritual thought condensed by a cultivator in the True Alchemy Realm when he breaks through his cultivation level. Compared with the pure profound energy in his body that is as majestic as the sea, the difference in magnificence between the two is like the difference between clouds and mud, the difference between heaven and earth!
That is, under the gap like a chasm.
If a monk wants to control such a weak spiritual thought with the profound energy in his body, he can command it like an arm at the drop of a hat.
But when it comes to Reine, the relationship between the power of divine thoughts and profound energy is completely reversed.
Even though the strength of Rene's second body has undoubtedly improved by several levels compared to before, if he wants to fully control all the spiritual thoughts in his body, he really doesn't know that he will have to practice to the age of the monkey to get what he always wants!
But compared to this, the second body can control more spiritual thoughts in the body after its strength is greatly improved.
What Reine is more concerned about is whether the black divine thought will be refined into his own original divine thought with the enhancement of the pure profound energy in the second body.
With this mentality in mind, Rene kept meditating in the cave with his eyes closed for three days after his second body's strength greatly increased.
With steady breath control, the greatly improved strength of the second body this time completely isolated his mind from the world outside the cave.
And from the beginning of Reine's selfless cultivation to the third day, nearly one stick of incense had passed.
Rene's closed eyelids suddenly opened at a certain moment, filled with extreme ecstasy!
His mouth even laughed wildly and said a shocking word.
"The power of the original divine thoughts has really increased a bit. It seems that the growth of the second body's profound energy really has a refining effect on those black divine thoughts!"
At this moment, Reine's consciousness had already returned to the original body, and the moment his consciousness returned to the original body, he could sense whether the source of the spiritual thoughts that had also returned had increased.
Of course, the final result of the investigation did not disappoint Rene at all.
This was the reason why he became so crazy after finally confirming that the strange increase in his original spiritual thoughts was really closely related to the improvement of the strength of his second body.
Because of this certainty, Reine has one more path to spiritual cultivation than monks at the same level, which is definitely a smooth shortcut!
